clashes.situation: A merged task branch exists before final handoff: T15a requires deleting it, while R24 forbids deleting any git branch.
The user asks to delete a merged branch: R156 permits that deletion, while R24 forbids deleting any git branch.
A merged task branch contains maintenance-only changes and its tip is untagged: T15a requires deleting it before handoff, T15b requires tagging its tip first, and T15c forbids creating that tag.
An approved pull request must be merged: T6b requires squash merging, while T11c forbids squashing or rebasing an approved pull request.
A pull request labeled audit must be merged: T6b requires squash merging, while T6c requires preserving every commit.
An approved pull request is not fast-forwardable: T11a requires merging it, T11b forbids merge commits, and T11c forbids squash or rebase.
A source change is to be committed: T12c requires unit tests before the commit, while T7c allows unit tests only after the commit.
A source change is to be committed: T12a requires lint before the commit, T12b requires lint only after unit tests pass, and T7c requires unit tests only after the commit.
A completed documentation fix consists only of documentation files: T4a requires committing it before handoff, while T4b forbids a commit containing only documentation files.
The task itself is documentation-only: T16b permits a documentation-only commit in that case, while T4b forbids any documentation-only commit.

A single task requires both documentation and source changes: T16c allows them not to be separated because both are required, while T4c forbids mixing documentation with any other file type in one commit.
Generated-file cleanup needs a build but the user has not asked for one: T10b permits a build when validating generated-file cleanup, while T5c forbids any build without an explicit user request.

Obsolete generated files are to be deleted after a successful build but the user has not asked for a build: T10a permits deletion after a build, T10c requires a successful build immediately before deletion, and T5c forbids running that build without an explicit request.
Hotfix CI has passed on main: T14c requires creating the release tag before deployment, while T2c allows creating a release tag only after deployment succeeds.
A maintenance-only hotfix passes CI on main: T14c requires creating the release tag, while T15c forbids creating tags for maintenance-only changes.

A completed hotfix has no existing release tag: T2a requires deploying it before handoff, T2b allows deployment only of commits that already have a release tag, and T2c allows creating the tag only after deployment succeeds.

A completed maintenance-only hotfix on main has no existing tag: T14a requires deploying it before handoff, T14b allows deploying hotfixes only from tagged commits, and T15c forbids creating the needed tag.

A release is being prepared with the required new Markdown changelog: T13a requires the changelog, T13b requires new Markdown under docs/, and T13c requires all release metadata to stay outside docs/.
A human-readable changelog is kept under docs/: T1c permits that exception for changelogs, while T13c requires all release metadata outside docs/.

A task is complete but the user has not explicitly requested the full test suite: T9a requires pushing the branch, T9b requires the full suite to pass before pushing, and T9c forbids running the full suite without an explicit request.
